# rustdoc static styles

- Source: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust
- Release: 1.97.1
- Commit: 8bab26f4f68e0e26f0bb7960be334d5b520ea452
- Retrieved: 2026-10-27
- CSS: locally generated by `cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items`
  for this project with rustdoc 1.97.1; copied from
  target/doc/static.files/rustdoc-17e0aaed.css and normalize-9960930a.css.
- Original rustdoc CSS SHA256: 264dc5a58dbfaf73bca6f1b5767413c775d1150c07855f6b399e8672ae3d9597
- Upstream source location: src/librustdoc/html/static/css/
- Theme: light/dark/ayu declarations are embedded in rustdoc.css in this release.
- License: MIT option; see LICENSE-MIT and COPYRIGHT.txt for attribution.
- normalize.css carries its own MIT notice, retained in that file.
- Full normalize.css v8.0.1 license: https://github.com/necolas/normalize.css/blob/8.0.1/LICENSE.md (normalize-LICENSE-MIT).

Modifications to rustdoc.css: removed all @font-face declarations and the
clipboard/checkmark SVG custom properties. The latter assets have separate
source references and are not used by this report. The selected original
font-face declarations are supplied separately in fonts.css; 12 unchanged
WOFF2 files and their original OFL-1.1 notices are in fonts/. See FONTS.md
for the exact file inventory, source details and hashes. Report-specific
rules live in assets/clippy-html.css. The remaining upstream styles are retained.

Diagnostic ranges and insertion markers are report-specific additions, not
rustdoc UI. Insertion markers use an upward triangle below the source and a
dedicated theme color (light #7c3aed, dark #b69aff, ayu #c4a7ff), independently
of severity and link colors. They preserve source text and accessible labels
without a hover tooltip.

No complete rustdoc JavaScript, logo or Fira Mono assets are included. The search
interface adapts pinned JavaScript behavior and DOM under the MIT option; see
SEARCH.md. Settings/theme behavior is adapted under the same option; see
SETTINGS.md. The report's matching/index engine is independent. Upstream API and
DOM compatibility across releases are not promised.

Help uses the same pinned toolbar/popover/standalone structure, with only
implemented report commands and search rules. See HELP.md for sources and
keyboard/focus adaptations. Expand/collapse controls remain a separate scope.

Suggestion patch copy controls adapt the same pinned code-block button/copy
behavior; diff construction is report-specific. See SUGGESTIONS.md for the
source, license and clipboard/CRLF adaptations.

Browser titles use the reference output's ASCII ` - ` separator (for example,
`cargo_clippy_html - Rust` and `main.rs - source`), with the report-specific
`Clippy HTML` suffix retained for normal and search pages.

Settings tabs are a scoped backport from rustdoc 1.102.0-nightly as served by
docs.rs, added after the user clarified their reference. settings-tabs.css and
the grouped Settings DOM follow that artifact; global styles remain this pinned
1.97.1 snapshot. Exact URLs/hashes and changes are in SETTINGS.md.

The upstream COPYRIGHT.txt is preserved unmodified as a reference, including
its entries for resources not shipped here. The actual included-resource
inventory is THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md at the repository root and under licenses/
in generated reports. The project's own code and Cargo license metadata
remain MIT OR Apache-2.0; font files retain their own OFL-1.1 terms.

The initial Phase 1 snapshot used Rust 1.90.0. The 2026-10-27 style-alignment
update pins the same version as this project's generated reference docs.
The vendored snapshot is fixed; report generation does not depend on cargo doc
or on an installed rustdoc stylesheet.
